1. (Currently amended) An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein said alignment device __comprises a processor configured to execute instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium to perform the alignment computation, and wherein said alignment device is operatively coupled to at least one sensor for capturing data regarding the demonstrated user actions__.

2. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment __and generates a signal indicating the identified current step__.

3. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, __wherein the highlighting comprises a visual indicator that distinguishes the current step from other steps in the documented procedure__.

4. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification, __wherein the highlighting is dynamically updated in real-time as the demonstrated user actions progress__.

5. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment __by predicting which step should follow the current step based on the computed alignment__.

6. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, __wherein the identification of the next step is provided prior to the user performing actions corresponding to the next step__.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification, __wherein the user interface automatically advances to display the next step upon completion of the current step__.

9. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, __wherein the similarity metric further comprises a comparison of semantic meaning between the common strings__.

10. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment, __wherein the alignment device processes the captured images to extract action features and compares the action features with document action specifications__.

11. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, __wherein the previous user experiences are stored in a database and weighted according to similarity to the current demonstrated user actions__.

12. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps, __wherein the document action extractor parses the documented procedure to identify step boundaries and step dependencies__.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, __wherein said alignment device comprises a processor configured to execute instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium__; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device.

15. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment, __wherein the alignment device extracts visual features from the captured images for comparison with document action specifications__.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, __wherein the previous user experiences are retrieved from a historical database and used to weight the alignment computation__.

17. (Currently amended) A method for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, __wherein the computing step is performed by a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium, and wherein the demonstrated user actions are captured by at least one sensor__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, __wherein the identifying step comprises determining which step in the documented procedure most closely matches the demonstrated user actions__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, __wherein the highlighting step visually distinguishes the current step from other steps in the documented procedure__.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, __wherein the identifying step comprises predicting which step should follow based on the computed alignment__.

21. (Currently amended) The method of claim 20, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, __wherein the identification of the next step is provided before the user performs actions corresponding to the next step__.

23. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, __wherein the similarity metric further comprises a semantic comparison of the common strings__.

24. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device, __wherein the computing step extracts visual features from the captured images and compares the visual features with document action specifications__.

25. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, __wherein the previous user experiences are retrieved from a database and weighted according to similarity to the current demonstrated user actions__.

26. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the method further comprises the step of extracting at least some of the plurality of steps from the documented procedure, __wherein the extracting step identifies step boundaries and step dependencies within the documented procedure__.

27. (Currently amended) A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions as recited in claim 17, __wherein the program instructions, when executed, cause the machine to capture demonstrated user actions via at least one sensor and compute the alignment using a processor__.

28. (Currently amended) A method for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the method comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, __wherein the computing step is performed by a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium__; visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the computed alignment; and automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the computed alignment.

31. (Currently amended) The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, __wherein the previous user experiences are retrieved from a historical database and used to weight the alignment computation__.

32. (Currently amended) A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface as recited in claim 28, __wherein the program instructions, when executed, cause the machine to compute the alignment using a processor and update the user interface display in real-time__.
